mainEntity.name: How do I test whether an AI data analyst gives correct answers before rolling it out?

acceptedAnswer.text: To test an AI data analyst before rollout, ask real questions with every right answer written down first.

mainEntity.name: We tested it and it was fine. Why is it worse three months later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anthropic reports that its offline accuracy drifted from about 95% at launch to about 65% over a month. That was before Anthropic treated it as an engineering problem.

mainEntity.name: How do I keep measuring accuracy after launch, not just at evaluation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Re-run the test on a schedule, and whenever something it depends on changes: a definition, a table, a model.

mainEntity.name: Does it keep context across follow-ups, and how do I test that?

acceptedAnswer.text: Test a follow-up chain, then ask one of its questions again, in full, in a fresh chat. In our follow-up run, Dot read the chain's first question by purchase date and kept that reading for 4 turns.
